lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's two thousand seventy? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 2070? Nope!

lines.text: Cross out the perfect squares: two, three, five, six, seven, eight, ten.
lines.caption: Cross out the perfect squares: 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10.

lines.text: What's the two thousand twenty-sixth number in the list?
lines.caption: What's the 2026th number in the list?

lines.text: Here's the trick. Every perfect square you cross out pushes the rest one spot along.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. Every perfect square you cross out pushes the rest one spot along.

lines.text: Ten sits in spot seven: seven, plus three squares!
lines.caption: 10 sits in spot 7: 7, plus 3 squares!

lines.text: Forty-five squared is two thousand twenty-five. That makes forty-five squares!
lines.caption: 45² is 2025. That makes 45 squares!

lines.text: Two thousand twenty-six plus forty-five is two thousand seventy-one!
lines.caption: 2026 plus 45 is... 2071!

lines.text: Two thousand seventy forgot that one is a square.
lines.caption: 2070 forgot that 1 is a square.

lines.text: Did you get two thousand seventy-one? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 2071? Tell me below!
